summary_en: 9,869,864 common shares (19.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) cancelled 29 June 2026. 125 Class-A preferred shares (100% of Class-A outstanding) cancelled same date. Post-cancellation: 40,598,798 common shares issued, 0 Class-A preferred shares issued.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: KYB Corporation completed the cancellation of treasury shares on 29 June 2026, in accordance with a resolution adopted by the board of directors on 8 April 2026. The cancellation comprised 9,869,864 common shares (representing 19.56% of issued common shares including treasury immediately before cancellation) and 125 Class-A preferred shares (100% of Class-A preferred shares issued). Following the cancellation, KYB has 40,598,798 issued common shares and zero issued Class-A preferred shares.
